rows.note: Use 神經 as the all-purpose choice for a body nerve and, in expressions, for the metaphorical or psychological ‘nerves’ sense.

example.english: The doctor said a nerve in my arm was being compressed.
example.traditional: 醫生話我手臂入面條神經畀壓住咗。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 sau2 bei3 jap6 min6 tiu4 san4 ging1 bei2 aat3 zyu6 zo2

rows.note: Use 膽量 for the courage or audacity someone shows in doing something bold or improper.

example.english: They really had the nerve to scold the manager in front of the customers.
example.traditional: 佢真係有膽量，夠膽當住客人面鬧個經理。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 daam2 loeng6 gau3 daam2 dong1 zyu6 haak3 jan4 min6 naau6 go3 ging1 lei5

rows.note: Use 緊張情緒 specifically for nervous agitation caused by fear, stress, or anticipation.

example.english: The nervous agitation before going onstage really made me lose my nerve.
example.traditional: 上台前嗰種緊張情緒，真係令我唔敢出聲。
example.jyutping: soeng6 toi1 cin4 go2 zung2 gan2 zoeng1 cing4 seoi5 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1
